name: SplitFlapStats
job: Show 2-4 key numbers on a departure-board split-flap display that flips into place
visitor_action: none (flips when in view); hover or focus replays one tile
mobile: first figure full width, the rest in two columns
motion: each digit flips through values with gravity-eased flaps and staggered landing; label lamps ignite and the board light warms up as they land (reduced-motion: final values, static)
art_direction: Station hall: matte charcoal flaps with hinge line, bone-white digits, amber label lamps, faint light falloff across the board
